about: Discovery Surf School is a family-run surf and SUP school in South Devon, operating since 2002 from bases at Bigbury-on-Sea and Bantham. Alongside lessons, it hires out surfboards, bodyboards, wetsuits, paddleboards and kayaks within walking distance of the local breaks.
goodToKnow: Weekly page lists hire opening times and conditions
Surfing England accredited for surfing; AALA registered for SUP
Instructors are DBS-checked SLSGB beach lifeguards
gaps: Hire terms and season dates sit on sub-pages that were not fetched.
